svg.aria-label: Grid of 30 stores. Each store has one row of five bars per browser (Mac, Anchor, Local) showing how far the reference agent got: product, cart, checkout, shipping details accepted, payment page.
svg.text: bot wall at the start page
Bars, left to right: product, cart, checkout, shipping, payment. Mac: Anchor on Mac hardware. Anchor: default session. Local: Chromium on a laptop.
